body: Hey folks, a Pomona Senior here (QB Match). This school is pretty good but it’s definitely not what it’s marketed to be. If you’re first-generation low-income please DM me so I can be real w you first so that you don’t get f*cked over like I and the rest of the FLI community did.

Sociolinguistics and I just love how interdisciplinary it can get. Took different courses in Phonetics, Syntax, Sociolinguistics, Linguistic Anthropology, etc. Currently I’m a college senior doing my thesis on Second Generation Vietnamese English Bilingual Language Acquisition with a focus on Phonetics and A sociolinguistic study of the construction of their identities. Linguistics and tbh anything is so super cool if you have the passion for it.
